plan.title: [framework-gap] finalize-owed probes each claim ref with its own unbounded ls-remote

narratives.Description: [framework-gap] finalize-owed probes each claim ref with its own unbounded ls-remote
narratives.Overview:
- Memoized first-demand claim batch — on first remoteClaimMeta demand in a discoverFinalizeOwed run, run one `git ls-remote --heads origin refs/heads/swarm/finalize/*`, map hits by exact full ref name, and reuse that in-memory map for later demands in both loops; completed loop still runs after nonterminal states are final; if no story reaches a probe demand, make no claim-probe network call; if that first-demand listing fails/times out/unparses/throws, treat every story that reached a probe demand as claim-unknown under the unknown wire (do not empty-map into owed, and do not re-probe per demand).
- Every production caller owns claimRunner — session-start and finalizeOwed each construct the bounded claim runner and pass claimRunner into discoverFinalizeOwed; discover resolves `options.claimRunner ?? options.runGit ?? defaultGitRunner` for claim ls-remote and claim hit-fetch only; do not attach the claim bound by `runGit === defaultGitRunner` identity comparison.
- Tip-fetch identity residual — leave fetchDeliveryTipPrivate's existing tip identity attach in place as a named residual; do not delete it under the claim-bound identity ban.
- Env-merging timed claim runner — the claimRunner constructor is a timed (30s) runner that can set GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 via an env/options bag on execGit; when env is supplied it must merge over process.env (never replace the child environment wholesale).
- Direct-child timeout class — the claim bound kills/times the direct git child; process-group kill stays outside this Bound.
- Bounded claim hit-fetch with reclaimable preserve — claim hit-fetch uses claimRunner; timeout/unparseable/non-reclaimable failures are unknown+blocking; isReclaimableClaimFetchFailure outcomes stay stale (self-clearing delete path) and are not remapped to unknown.
- Unknown at today's classification points — for a story that reached the probe, claim ls-remote failure/timeout/unparseable/throw and non-reclaimable hit-fetch failure set unknown through inventory formatting and finalizeOwed; preserve each loop's existing issue-state exemptions (closed stay exempt; protectedUmbrella exempts unmarked admits in the nonterminal loop and qualifying completed-loop stories); marked nonterminal protectedUmbrella leftovers remain unknown+blocking on claim failure unless deferred; unverifiable issue-state stays unknown+blocking; never surface raw remote stdout/stderr.
- Dedupe includes unknown — add unknown to the completed-loop twin-dedupe allowlist so one batch failure does not emit duplicate blocking rows / duplicate issue reads for the same identity.
- finalizeOwed unknown terminal — on the ordinary finalizeOwed path (not --inventory-only / --dry-run), unknown stories must force a non-zero exit so the command cannot exit 0 while the session gate stays blocked; inventory-only/dry-run stay report-only.
- Behavior-class semantics with snapshot residual — when claim metadata is successfully obtained, owed / close-owed / in-flight / stale stay behavior-class equivalent to today modulo the memoized-batch snapshot age across the remaining O(n) gh leg; tryClaimRef create-only --force-with-lease remains the double-claim backstop; name that snapshot-age residual rather than asserting byte-perfect in-flight equivalence for the whole inventory.
- Direct-child Risk note — document that the 30s claim bound is on the direct child, not a wall-clock bound on session:start: an orphan helper holding inherited pipes can keep the sync call blocked past the child timeout on every platform, and win32 has no process-group kill option; do not invent a fake win32 group kill.
narratives.UserStory: As a session operator, finalize-owed claim probing must use one bounded batched ls-remote instead of unbounded per-ref probes.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Stamp Prefer-A Recut-5 Bound 6692703907: memoized claim batch; caller-owned claimRunner; reclaimable preserve; unknown terminal non-zero exit.
